mapper.sql: select cc.id, cc.course_id, cc.skill_tag_id, cc.score, cc.level, cc.rationale, cc.matched_keywords, c.code as course_code, c.title_zh as course_title, t.code as skill_code, t.name as skill_name, t.category as skill_category from edu_course_competency cc inner join edu_skill_tag t on t.skill_tag_id = cc.skill_tag_id left join edu_course c on c.course_id = cc.course_id
mapper.select: inner join edu_course_record r on r.course_id = cc.course_id where r.student_id = #{studentId} and r.passed = '1' and r.record_status = 'COMPLETED' and r.del_flag = '0' and t.del_flag = '0' group by cc.id order by t.category asc, cc.score desc

select t.skill_tag_id, t.code, t.name, t.category, t.school_abbr, t.description, t.keywords, t.sort_order, t.status, t.create_time, count(distinct cc.course_id) as course_count, round(avg(cc.score), 1) as avg_score from edu_skill_tag t left join edu_course_competency cc on cc.skill_tag_id = t.skill_tag_id where t.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0'
and t.school_abbr = #{schoolAbbr}
and (t.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.keywords like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
group by t.skill_tag_id order by t.sort_order asc, t.skill_tag_id asc
